blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–It’s not just through her groundbreaking exploits on the tennis court that Alex Eala has won the hearts of Filipino fans. Despite spending much of her life overseas after moving to Spain at the age of 13, Eala has remained connected to her Filipino roots–something admirers have pointed to as part of her charm. READ: Alex Eala moved by heartfelt encounters with Filipino fans Aside from making it a point to address supporters in Filipino during postmatch interviews, the WTA world No. 15 has also kept up with what could be described as distinctly Filipino humor.
